parsedVerdict.reasoning: This file contains small helpers that read raw HTTP request bodies and query values. They check that each field is present and has the right primitive type, and throw ValidationError when it doesn't. That is input parsing at the transport/controller boundary, which belongs in an infrastructure (adapter) file. The helpers encode no business rules: there are no domain invariants, no entity rules and no conditions specific to any use case. They only check types and presence on untyped input. They also don't handle persistence or orchestrate application work. Throwing a domain error type is a dependency matter, and dependency rules are out of scope here.
